material_decisions.ruling: English p2 passes fidelity but is rejected: affirmative gzhi gnyis ... ji ltar rigs par sbyar ro does not mean the rhetorical rejection of a second basis. Retain separately useful dge/virtuous, mi dge/non-virtuous, la sogs pa/and the rest, later bag chags/mental seeds, gzhan/other and newly recovered gzhi/basis. Narrow other types to other, leaving types and deeds unwrapped. gnyis/two must not bank second one as a lexical ordinal; the remaining disputed application frame is omitted, never null.

Reverse Tibetan omission and keep English local attestation with quotes removed: continuity at 256–266 follows exactly the four-item source list mur thug pa, goms pa, rtsa ba, bag chags. No HGM equivalent exists for mur thug pa; the LC Sanskrit niṣṭha is comparandum, not an HGM definition. ILL:1924 paraphrases continued duration and ILL:4354 has final destination. These are divergent readings, not proof that the locally identified item cannot align. This is the least secure retained lexical unit and remains explicitly provisional.

Prefer flat ma rig pa/ignorance and bag chags/mental seed to the English-angle seed-of-ignorance parent, and flat sems/mind and rgyud/flow. Narrow 'gag par byed/tends to stop and sgo bar byed/stain to 'gag/stop and sgo/stain; byed/tends scaffolding is not a lexical compound. Keep rjes su bgrod par byed pa/continue on at d3, correcting English d5 depth.

rnam grangs/same thing is the tighter direct HGM attestation and the local list-equivalence predicate, preferred to expressions. Keep nyon mongs pa/mental affliction twice, excluding state of and itself. Split spangs su zin, spang bar mi nus and bsal du zin into spangs/eliminated, zin/already #1, spang/eliminate, mi nus/unable, bsal/remove and zin/already #2. Explicit subword=true on mi/un member. The only paired kyang is even though in the first elimination clause.

Retain til mar with til/sesame and mar/butter, rang sangs rgyas with sangs rgyas/Buddhas, dang/or, me tog/flowers #1, bum pa/vase and snam bu/piece of cloth (HGM direct). English later flowers and butter are supplied explanations, unpaired. Split de dang phrad pas/due to the previous contact into phrad/contact and pas/due to; previous is not licensed by demonstrative de. Split yon tan phra mo into trace/subtle, and bzhin no to bzhin/similar. Preserve gsungs/says omitted by English proposal.

The final two bag chags occurrences at 562–571 and 586–595 share the single English mental seeds noun. The retained la sogs pa at 573–583 makes w47 resolve to the later occurrence; the first is genuinely distributed, not nulled as an artificial cursor anchor. dmigs pa/retain changes perspective and remains unpaired; tshul/how-works, list hinges, genitives, byed and other auxiliaries remain unwrapped. Full offsets and contexts cover every actual proposal and final span.
